paper_proxy_limitations: Analytic opportunity index, NOT damage telemetry or real Godot combat simulation. Rare profile inherits Divine 4 actives, basic, 5 passives, innate, replaces ultimate and passive05; basic CD uses same tier. Does not factor cast/GCD, travel, AI selection, real mob distribution, crit, enemy resist/defense, mark uplifts, exact 5-stack contention. DoT opportunity 0.65 heuristic. Consume bonus assumes S=2, 4 remaining ticks of ratio .03 and clamps to 0.256. Must run exact Godot for PASS.
